route.lua: local S = nova.scene_now(); S.state = 'fight'; S.wave_i = #S.def.waves; S.countdown = nil

CLEARED_B = require('lib.banner').visible(); local b = require('lib.banner').list[1]; CLEARED_SUB = b and b.sub or ''; local c = nova.all('card')[1]; nova.named('runner').x, nova.named('runner').y = c.x, c.y + 24
